label: copy-phase input b, late in the copy or followed by a/b output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the fed-back input is b (97% of mass; a few weak activations on input a). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, nor on the first occurrence of a token. Only about 9.5% of copy-phase b inputs fire. Rate and magnitude rise with position: late copy steps (t>=13, recall_idx>=4, long L=8-9 sequences) and when the token being output right after b is a (precision 0.6-0.8) or b. The strongest examples are ...b a... bigrams recalled late in long sequences. On dev, copy-phase b alone gives recall 0.96 but precision 0.09; the chosen predicate (b input AND (t>=14 OR output a/b)) gives F1 0.45 and mass recall 0.87. The weak low-quartile activations on b at early copy positions are not captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: b, a, q, j, -, <DEL>; least: s, m, d, 0) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: a, b, s, p; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=15, recall_idx=6.
